No. : +91-129-2310400 Website : www.netwebindia.com; E-mail : complianceofficer@netwebindia.com PRESS RELEASE Netweb Technologies Launches Skylus Workspaces, a Next-Generation Enterprise Digital Workspace Platform for the AI Era Extending digital workspaces beyond traditional desktops to enterprise applications, AI development environments and accelerated computing, with greater control over infrastructure, security and data. New Delhi, India — 27th November 2026: Netweb Technologies India Limited, a leading Indian provider of high-end computing solutions, today announced the launch of Skylus Workspaces, the next-generation enterprise digital workspace platform designed to address the evolving computing requirements of organizations in the AI era. The launch strengthens Netweb’s enterprise software portfolio, extending its capabilities from building advanced computing infrastructure to developing platforms that make such infrastructure accessible, manageable, and productive across the enterprise. Skylus Workspaces brings together virtual desktops, enterprise applications, containerized environments and access to AI and high-performance computing (HPC) resources within a unified, secure and centrally managed platform. Enterprise Computing Is Moving Beyond the Desktop For decades, enterprise digital workspaces have largely revolved around delivering desktops and applications to users. AI is now expanding that mandate. While traditional business users continue to need secure access to enterprise applications, an increasingly AI-enabled workforce requires access to data, AI tools, specialised development environments and accelerated computing resources. As job roles evolve with AI, enterprise workspaces must evolve too… Skylus Workspaces addresses this transformation by extending the traditional virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) model into a more comprehensive digital workspace experience, bringing everyday enterprise computing and specialised AI workloads together on a common platform. Bringing the Power of AI Infrastructure to the Enterprise Workforce As organisations invest in AI infrastructure, an equally important challenge is making these computing resources accessible to the people who need them. Skylus Workspaces is designed to enable enterprises to deliver role-specific computing environments without requiring every user to have a dedicated high-performance hardware at their desk. The platform combines: • Unified Enterprise Workspaces: Access to Windows, Linux, virtual desktops, enterprise applications and containerised environments through a common platform. • AI

BRUNSWICK, N.J. – Nov. 25, 2026 - bp has today announced a strategic supplier partnership with Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO), a leading AI-powered technology services and consulting company, to transform its core finance operations as it continues to strengthen performance and improve long-term cost competitiveness. The collaboration will bring together Wipro’s expertise in AI, automation, and transformation to drive greater efficiency in bp’s finance operations and improve processes. Under the agreement, around 3,000 bp employees supporting finance operations in India, Hungary and Malaysia will move to Wipro. Through this collaboration, we aim to unlock measurable business outcomes for bp in the AI-first world. I also welcome the bp employees joining the Wipro family and look forward to integrating their specialized skills with our consulting-led, AI-powered strategy.” The new operating model is expected to take effect in 2027, subject to applicable conditions. bp will retain overall accountability for standards, controls, data and technology governance, with PwC providing controls oversight.
